# ggml-rpc-server --help, llama.cpp b12500 (llama-b12500-bin-macos-arm64.tar.gz, sha256 afe4188c1ffab52b9b39ea688c8fa49f1012b826282b5c11eee5e9b9c757e1aa); the Linux tarballs ship the same binary name.
Usage: ./llama-b12500/ggml-rpc-server [options]

options:
  -h, --help                       show this help message and exit
  -t, --threads N                  number of threads for the CPU device (default: 5)
  -d, --device <dev1,dev2,...>     comma-separated list of devices
  -H, --host HOST                  host to bind to (default: 127.0.0.1)
  -p, --port PORT                  port to bind to (default: 50052)
  -c, --cache                      enable local file cache
